decisions.reason: Packaging every file in a complete v25 ZIP does not change the required Master-template table guidance or its acceptable format.
The package version and archive structure do not resolve or alter the required Tab-driven list behavior.
Including the Board Meeting file in the v25 package does not change its field-alignment requirement.
The complete v25 package instruction does not alter the established Board Meeting row-insertion workflow.
The archive and versioning decision does not change the date selector's input method, display format, or applicable contexts.
Creating a complete v25 ZIP does not change the required behavior for copying legacy content into the templates.
The packaging instruction does not modify bullet dimensions, appearance, spacing, alignment, or level-four styling.
The package format and v25 suffix do not alter column containment or text-wrapping behavior.
The source decision concerns delivery packaging and does not change numbered-list alignment behavior.
The complete v25 ZIP requirement does not change manual line-break behavior after legacy-content pasting.
Naming the delivered files v25 does not modify the internal PBU style-name prefix, language, or covered style categories.
Requiring every file in a complete v25 package does not change the existing requirement to apply the specified style system consistently across all templates.
